title: Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer - Data & Intelligence Platforms
description:
Back to jobs New Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer - Data & Intelligence Platforms Berlin | Hybrid; Munich | Hybrid Apply Job description Team & Reporting Line: Data Platforms / Intelligence | Data & Analytics Our Mission At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth - where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions. From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world. Your Role We are building the next generation of thermal satellites. This is not a concept on a slide: our first two SkyBee satellites have been in orbit since 2025, each flying a cryocooled thermal infrared instrument on a microsatellite, and, backed by a €37M Series A, our next satellites are already in the pipeline. But turning their data into reliable products requires a platform where teams can experiment quickly and move successful ideas safely into production. That’s where you come in. In Data & Analytics, we are building the team that will turn this data into AI-powered intelligence products across all customer segments: for defence and security customers in National Security and Maritime Awareness; for public-sector customers in Urban Dynamics and Food & Water Security; and for commercial customers in Industrial Monitoring, delivered directly and through partner platforms. Beyond that, we are laying the groundwork for multi-domain intelligence integration, for example as part of a European sovereign space intelligence consortium. Join constellr as a Senior DevOps / Platform Engineer for Data & Intelligence Platforms and build the foundations that connect experimentation with production. You will work across our Data Platform and Product Innovation / Intelligence activities, owning and evolving the cloud and Kubernetes foundations, deployment workflows, observability and developer environments that allow teams to ship safely and quickly. A key part of the role is designing and providing lightweight, repeatable sandbox environments as a platform capability, giving engineering and intelligence teams the autonomy to experiment without turning every prototype into permanent infrastructure. You will also establish a clear path for successful prototypes to graduate from these environments into reliable, supported production services. You will help evolve how we build and operate software using modern AI-assisted engineering and automation, from development and testing through deployment and operations. Success means that creating, deploying, operating and scaling a service becomes fast and predictable, from the first experiment to production. Key responsibilities Build, operate and evolve the cloud and Kubernetes platform supporting our data processing, APIs and intelligence services. Own and improve infrastructure-as-code, GitOps and CI/CD workflows so environments and services can be provisioned, deployed, upgraded and rolled back reliably and repeatably. Design and provide clear environment patterns for development, sandbox, test and production, enabling Fast-Forward and product engineers to deploy and validate experiments independently within well-defined security, cost and operational boundaries. Build observability into the platform through metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and actionable alerting, helping teams understand system health and identify issues before they affect users or data delivery. Improve reliability and scalability of data-intensive workloads, including APIs, event-driven services, workflow orchestration, databases, object storage and large geospatial data processing. Partner with application and data engineers on Kubernetes, networking, storage, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, queues and caching, troubleshooting issues across infrastructure and application boundaries when needed. Establish practical reliability practices including backup and recovery, capacity planning, incident response, service ownership, security hardening and controlled upgrade paths for production systems. Provide the infrastructure patterns needed for AI and geospatial intelligence workloads, including vector and search services, model and agent services, and compute-intensive analytical workflows, without over-engineering experimental use cases. Continuously reduce operational friction and cloud cost through automation, reusable platform components, good defaults and self-service capabilities, while documenting the paths teams should use from sandbox to supported production. Establish a clear and repeatable path from sandbox to production, allowing successful prototypes to graduate into supported services without unnecessary rework. Use AI-assisted engineering and automation to improve infrastructure development, testing, troubleshooting and operations, while maintaining strong review, security and production standards. Job requirements About you Required: Strong hands-on experience (5+ years) operating production cloud infrastructure and containerised services, with deep practical knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, including deployment, debugging, upgrades, networking and storage. Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automated delivery practices such as Terraform, OpenTofu, Pulumi or Ansible, together with CI/CD and GitOps approaches for creating repeatable environments and supporting a clear path from experimentation to production. Strong Linux and cloud engineering fundamentals, including networking, identity and access management, secrets, storage, compute and security concepts in AWS, GCP or comparable environments. Experience building observability for distributed systems using metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards and alerting, and a reliability mindset where operational visibility is part of the definition of done. Experience operating data-intensive production systems and databases such as PostgreSQL/PostGIS, including backup/recovery, performance awareness and working effectively with application engineers on production issues. Ability to automate operational work using Python, Go, shell or similar languages, and to understand application code and APIs well enough to troubleshoot across the boundary between software and infrastructure. A pragmatic platform mindset: able to balance reliability, developer experience, security, cost and delivery speed, and turn recurring engineering needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities. Experience using modern AI-assisted or agentic engineering tools to accelerate infrastructure development, automation and troubleshooting, while critically reviewing generated changes and maintaining ownership of security and production quality. Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a national security clearance (e.g. German Ü2/Ü3 or equivalent), as the role involves work for defence and security customers. Nice to Have : Experience with geospatial or Earth observation platforms, STAC, COGs, object storage, large raster/vector datasets or satellite-data processing pipelines. Experience with workflow and event-driven infrastructure such as Argo Workflows, Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ or similar systems, particularly for data-processing workloads. Experience operating infrastructure for AI/LLM and data-intensive analytical workloads, including vector databases, model or agent services, GPU workloads and analytical engines such as DuckDB. Experience with deeper Kubernetes/platform engineering topics such as operators, service mesh, multi-cluster environments, policy-as-code, autoscaling, cost optimisation, developer portals or self-service platform tooling. Why join constellr? High-Impact National Security Mission: Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies. Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation: Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match. Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure: Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers. Inclusive & Scientific Culture: Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy. Financial Upside & Well-being: Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.
